lines.en: I glide a stretch through the air.
My toes float an inch off the ground.
My pale body skims the treetops.
I settle and take two steps.
My ki lifts me upward.
I drift sideways, unhurried.
One turn of the ankle changes my course.
I float past the eaves.
I skim low over the ground.
A cold trail follows me.
I turn sideways through the narrow gap.
I rise level with you.
I hover, my sleeves stirring.
Cold air curls around me.
I lift a hand and study my palm.
I sit cross-legged in the air.
My gaze sweeps the clearing.
I am calm; the patient one wins.
A chill gathers at my fingertip.
I tilt my head back slightly.
My hem is tugged by the current.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口白色的寒气
lines.en: I exhale a white mist.
I hover, waiting for one move.
My body turns half a circle.
My shadow on the ground stays still.
I brush away a falling leaf.
I look down at you, faintly amused.
Still standing? Bold of you.

lines.zh: 冰屑在我轨迹上结成霜。
lines.en: Ice shards frost over along my flight path.
I stop where you can see me.
I have read your strength.
After you, I insist.
Frostlight flickers in my eyes.
I tilt my head at your breathing.
Your clenched fist gives you away.
I raise a hand to measure you.
This height will do.
I smile without a sound.
Your footsteps slipped half a beat.
I fold my arms across my chest.
I let you finish your words.
I dislike looking up at anyone.
Your energy feels familiar.
I note your stance first.
You actually landed one.
I drift half a block and steady.
My chill wavers for a moment.
That one had some bite.
A slit opens in my sleeve.
My brow furrows.
My ki runs wild inside.
I wipe blood from my lip.
I drop half a block.
I will remember that strength.

lines.zh: 你觉得这样能引我下来
lines.en: You think that will draw me down?

lines.zh: 我瞥了一眼你手里的东西
lines.en: I glance at what you hold.

lines.zh: 这点小东西也想收买我
lines.en: You would bribe me with that?
I reach out, then withdraw.
Your offering is thin.
I drift a little lower.
Interesting, let me see.
I raise one eyebrow.

lines.zh: 这不像是对手该做的事
lines.en: This is no way to fight.
I laugh at how naive you are.
You blunder into my frost.
Your shove pushes me back a bit.
I slip aside; you miss.
My chill clings to you.
I float half a block higher.
The bump flutters my hem.
I put a hand out to steady you.
Running into me gains nothing.
I drop one block lower.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀穿过我的气流
lines.en: Your shoulder passes through my current.
She hovers level with me.
We exchange one glance.
Two cold trails coil together.
She floats half a step to my left.
We turn the same way at once.
I hold her hem down for her.
She says my strikes are slow.
We lift off, one behind the other.
She knows my next move.
Together we look down at the ground.
I draw it up with my ki.
I catch the bead between my fingers.

lines.zh: 地上的东西自己浮起来
lines.en: It rises from the ground itself.

lines.zh: 我伸手接住落下的碎屑
lines.en: I catch the falling debris.
I tuck it into my sleeve.
I inspect it, then drop it.
The current carries it to me.
I bend to pick up a tile.
I catch a pellet without looking.

lines.zh: 我一弹指把它送回地面
lines.en: I flick it back to the ground.
I see you clearly now.
A ki blast gathers in my palm.
No more courtesies from me.
I rise to a better angle.
You have shown me a gap.
Cold light kindles at my fingertips.
First I close your escape.
Your speed is not enough.
Before I freeze you, let me hear your heartbeat.
This time I strike first.
I shift my weight half an inch forward.
You are standing just right.

lines.zh: 我要在你出手前击中你
lines.en: I will hit you before you strike.
The air begins to circle you.

lines.zh: 我的寒气，先把地面冻住。
lines.en: My cold freezes the ground first.
I uncross my arms.
I drift slowly over your head.
The blast follows you.
Where you go, my aim goes.
I hold three tenths of my power back.

lines.zh: 你每一次抬手我都记着
lines.en: I log every time you raise a hand.
I wait for your ki to drop.
The chill wraps your ankles.
You cannot reach my altitude.
I drift half a step back and aside.
This one must land clean.
There is a seam in your guard.
I press my fingers together.
A little lower and I fire.
You hesitate; I press in.
The cold light travels up my arm.
I have your landing spot.
The wind drowns your footsteps.
I could strike at any moment.
I push out a palm of cold light.

lines.zh: 气弹贴着你的肩膀炸开
lines.en: The blast bursts at your shoulder.
I raise a hand and the beam lances out.
Three shots, no gap for you.
He misses; I am already behind him.

lines.zh: 我留下残影，本体已移开
lines.en: I leave an afterimage and move.
My toe taps his chest.

lines.zh: 气功屏障挡下他的反击
lines.en: My ki barrier eats his counter.
An aerial combo drives him down.

lines.zh: 我一拳贴着他耳朵过去
lines.en: My fist passes his ear.

lines.zh: 冷光在他脚边冻结土地
lines.en: Cold light freezes the ground at his feet.
He coughs out a breath.
I follow him down to the ground.

lines.zh: 这一发射穿了他的防御
lines.en: This shot pierces his guard.
He dodges; the wall does not.
I lower my palm; the ki still hangs.
I descend slowly from the air.
The chill rolls out ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我的影子上没有脚步声
lines.en: My shadow comes without footsteps.
I halt one block above the ground.

lines.zh: 空气里的温度掉了几度
lines.en: The air drops a few degrees.
I raise my eyes to this place.
Someone has disturbed the dragon's power.

lines.zh: 我从裂开的天空里出来
lines.en: I come out of the split sky.
My sleeves are still drifting.

lines.zh: 我先转了一圈看清场子
lines.en: I turn once to read the field.
Frost forms on the stones.
I hang there without a word.

lines.zh: 这具身体落地时没有声音
lines.en: This body lands without a sound.
I let the current spread first.
You had all better step back.
When I open my eyes, all is white.
I have been woken.
This ground is mine to watch.
Heat scatters my cold aura.
I drop a stretch before catching myself.
The water crushes my ki.
The blast tears my barrier.
Something pierced my aura.
A spell binds my wrist.
My ki drains away.
Lightning passes through me.
The void pulls at my hem.
